subject: Skip metadata reconciliation after replica demotion (#1304)
reason: The only behavioral change is a race guard added inside the asynchronous RunByMain callback in MetadataManager::HandleBroadcastedMetadata: it re-checks vmsdk::IsReplica(ctx) on the main thread after the gRPC GetGlobalMetadata fetch returns, discarding the reconciliation if the node was demoted between accepting the broadcast and applying the fetched metadata. The other two hunks (HandleBroadcastedMetadata's top check and CreateEntryOnReplica) and the new vmsdk::IsReplica helper are mechanical refactors of an identical expression, no behavior change.
